choices.robust_pool: Selected analysed signal, all 0-6-s samples from dataset-unflagged trials, before evoked subtraction; first differences within trials only
choices.robust_thresholds: Same amplitude median/MAD and absolute first-difference threshold as Amendment 3
choices.primary_mask: Amendment-3 selected-pair retained mask AND selected bipolar 0-6-s robust mask
choices.sensitivity_b_mask: Amendment-3 selected-pair retained mask AND deeper-contact 0-6-s robust mask
choices.sensitivity_a_mask: Dataset artifact flags only: the unchanged sensitivity (a) omits robust amplitude/first-difference rejection at both stages
choices.templates: Separate included-trial mean waveform per analysis/patient/session/signal, computed after its own mask; no post-subtraction rejection; session/patient eligibility after masking
choices.notch: Full native trial cut and MATLAB resample, full 8-s mean removal, same fourth-order digital SOS notches at 50/100/150 +/-1 Hz, then samples 1:12000
choices.welch: Symmetric hann(2000), overlap1000, nfft2000, fs2000, equal-trial mean PSD after evoked subtraction
choices.spectral_peak: Largest residual over 1-12 Hz above ordinary log10(power)-on-log10(frequency) linear fit
choices.progress_check: sub-01 ses-01 all planned analysed signals first; counts logged, not a gate; automatic continuation without tuning
